name: Playtika
description: Herzliya-headquartered, Nasdaq-listed (PLTK) mobile games company founded in 2010 by Robert Antokol and Uri Shahak; portfolio includes Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, Caesars Slots, Solitaire Grand Harvest, Pirate Kings, Best Fiends, WSOP and Dice Dreams. Acquired studios include Jelly Button, Wooga, Seriously and Innplay Labs.

relations.note: Music for Solitaire Grand Harvest campaigns

notes: ~3,500 employees end of 2024; ~20% workforce cut announced Nov 2025 (Wikipedia). 'The Legend' WSOP film was created in-house by Playtika.
description_he: חברת משחקי מובייל שמטהּ בהרצליה, נסחרת בנאסד"ק (PLTK), ונוסדה ב-2010 על ידי רוברט אנטוקול ואורי שחק; בפורטפוליו: Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, Caesars Slots, Solitaire Grand Harvest, Pirate Kings, Best Fiends, WSOP ו-Dice Dreams. בין הסטודיו שרכשה: Jelly Button, Wooga, Seriously ו-Innplay Labs.
